policy.purpose: Primary-source anchors for original question generation and currentness audits.
policy.default: Use facts to create original wording. Do not reproduce third-party CQ/Answer, figures, algorithms, tables or images unless an explicit reusable-rights basis is recorded.
policy.medicalRule: Clinical assertions require a current authoritative source and sourceCheckedAt. If a source is superseded, affected production questions lose PASS status until revalidated.
